findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name JSON schema remote reference fetching
 * @description Detects use of requests or urllib to fetch remote schemas or resources, which may be vulnerable to SSRF or insecure transport.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/remote-fetch-usage
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "request", "Session"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall()
select call, "Remote HTTP(S) request; ensure callers control destinations safely to avoid SSRF or insecure transport."
findings.hypothesis: The library may fetch remote JSON Schemas or resources over HTTP using requests/urllib, which could be an SSRF vector depending on how URLs are controlled.

message.text: Remote HTTP(S) request; ensure callers control destinations safely to avoid SSRF or insecure transport.
